title: 3,000 drones light up Changchun sky ahead of PLA Air Force anniversary-Xinhua
text:
# 3,000 drones light up Changchun sky ahead of PLA Air Force anniversary

Editor: huaxia

2026-11-10 14:21:15

A spectacular drone show lit up the night sky over Changchun, northeast China, on Monday, with 3,000 drones forming images celebrating the upcoming 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force on November 11. #J20 #Y20 #Drone #DroneShow #Aviation #AirForce #China #PLA
